title: Payments Subject to Benefit Withholding and Deduction Orders — Program and Payment-Type Coverage
content:
Whether a given benefit payment is reachable by Benefit Withholding and Deduction Orders depends on the program it is paid under, whether it is a regular, supplemental or reissued payment, and whether the week is a waiting week or the claim is on hold with no payment issued.

| Kind | Payments under UCFE, UCX, EB, TRA and DUA | Supplemental and reissued payments | Reissued payment whose cancelled original had a deduction | Anything deducted for a waiting week | Deductions pause while the claim is on hold because no payment is issued |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Voluntary Federal Income Tax Withholding | Subject | Subject | Deduction carried, not retaken | No | Yes |
| Voluntary State Income Tax Withholding | Subject | Subject | Deduction carried, not retaken | No | Yes |
| Child Support Withholding — Current Support Order | Subject | Subject | Deduction carried, not retaken | No | Yes |
| Child Support Withholding — Arrears-Only Order | Subject | Subject | Deduction carried, not retaken | No | Yes |
| SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Household or Agency Error | Subject | Subject | Deduction carried, not retaken | No | Yes |
| SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Intentional Program Violation | Subject | Subject | Deduction carried, not retaken | No | Yes |

## Reading the matrix

The six rows are identical, so each column can be read as a statement about every kind of Benefit Withholding and Deduction Orders:

- **Federal programs.** Payments under Unemployment Compensation for Federal Employees (UCFE), Unemployment Compensation for Ex-Servicemembers (UCX), Extended Benefits (EB), Trade Readjustment Allowances (TRA) and Disaster Unemployment Assistance (DUA) are subject to every kind.
- **Supplemental and reissued payments.** These are subject to every kind.
- **Reissue.** When a cancelled payment had a deduction taken from it and the payment is reissued, the deduction is carried to the reissued payment and is not taken a second time.
- **Waiting week.** Nothing is deducted for a waiting week under any kind.
- **Claim on hold.** While the claim is on hold because no payment is issued, deductions pause under every kind.

## Illustrative situations (hypothetical)

| Situation | Subject to deduction under the kinds above? |
|---|---|
| A weekly payment under Trade Readjustment Allowances | Yes — the program is covered |
| A supplemental payment | Yes — supplemental payments are covered |
| A reissue of a cancelled payment from which a deduction had been taken | The original deduction is carried; no second deduction |
| A week served as the waiting week | No |
| A week in which the claim is on hold and no payment is issued | No — deductions pause |
